messages.subject: constraints in regression coefficients
parts:
I am trying to put constraints on regression coefficients
form<-Y~   A1+A2+A3 + B1+ B2+B3

I want to constraint 
A1=B1
A2=B2
A3=B3.

Any tips?


Alok

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] constraints in regression coefficients
parts:
A1B1 = A1 + B1
A2B2 = A2 + B2
A3B3 = A3 + B3

then

form = Y ~ A1B1 + A2B2 + A3B3


if you need something else there are various tricks which can be used
